backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the backend canister with types for Questions, UserProfiles, and SubscriptionPlans, plus CRUD endpoints for questions, user profiles, subscription plans, and arrays, all gated by role-based access control via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single feature requirement (REQ-40) to remove frontend-side unauthorized error display in AdminPanelScreen.tsx, keeping only the password gate 'Naeem9472' for access control.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's React/TypeScript frontend components, hooks, pages, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes including background, foreground, primary, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Vite/React app titled 'AIAPGET Unani PYQ Practice', mounting the React app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing screen navigation state across all app screens (home, quiz, results, review, topics, history, admin, subscription, payment), rendering the persistent AppHeader on non-quiz screens and wrapping everything in QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Persistent sticky app header with a kebab (3-dot) dropdown navigation menu linking to all main screens including Home, Quiz, Topics, History, Subscription Plans, and Admin Panel, with active-state highlighting and outside-click dismissal.
frontend/src/data/questions.ts: Defines the Question interface, topic/year constants, and a large static array of Unani medicine quiz questions with answers and explanations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching admin questions, adding new questions to the backend, and merging backend questions with static local questions for the full question list.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for storing and retrieving quiz attempt history on the ICP backend, encoding/decoding attempts as packed bigint arrays.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionQuerie: Provides a React Query hook to fetch available subscription plans from the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines light/dark theme CSS custom properties for a parchment/teal color scheme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelScreen.tsx: Password-protected admin panel screen for adding new quiz questions to the backend, with a form, topic/year selectors, and a list view of existing backend questions.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryScreen.tsx: Displays the user's quiz attempt history with summary stats (attempts, average score, best score) and a list of individual attempts with grades. Includes a clear history button that calls the actor's clearArray method.
frontend/src/pages/HomeScreen.tsx: The main home screen showing a hero banner, stats row, and navigation cards for starting a quiz, browsing by topic/year, viewing history, subscription plans, and the admin panel. Merges static and backend questions for display.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentMethodSelector: A payment method selection screen supporting UPI, credit/debit card, net banking, and wallets with relevant input fields. Simulates payment processing with a mock delay and shows a success confirmation screen on completion.
frontend/src/pages/QuizScreen.tsx: Renders an interactive quiz with one question at a time, showing answer options that highlight correct/incorrect selections after answering. Tracks answers and elapsed time, then calls onComplete when the last question is submitted.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsScreen.tsx: Shows quiz results including score percentage, performance tier, correct/incorrect/skipped counts, and time taken. Automatically records the attempt via a mutation hook on mount and provides options to review answers or start a new quiz.
frontend/src/pages/ReviewScreen.tsx: Displays a post-quiz answer review screen, showing each question with correct/incorrect/skipped status, highlighted options, and explanation. Supports navigation between questions via prev/next buttons.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPlansScre: Renders a subscription plans page with monthly (₹199) and yearly (₹1,499) plan cards, a toggle to switch between them, and a button that navigates to the payment screen with the selected plan details.
frontend/src/pages/TopicBrowserScreen.ts: Shows a browsable list of questions organized by topic or year, fetched from the backend, with expandable accordion sections and a button to start a shuffled quiz from any group.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), an OKLCH-based color palette, border radius tokens, box shadows, accordion animations, and plugin registrations.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 35) for an AIAPGET Unani MCQ prep app, listing existing features, known issues (admin panel bugs, answer color contrast), and architectural notes.
